messages:
sarah_sales: Hey team — customer 'GlacierAI' wants a 6-week POC and needs a reserved GPU pool + autoscale/burst during demo windows. Asking for pricing guidance and deal-desk ok.
lisa_se: Quick summary of ask?
ryan_enginfra: They want 8xA10g steady, plus ability to burst to 16 (mix of A10g + A100-sim) for 2 hours a day, 5 days/wk. Autoscale target latency SLO 95th < 280ms. Data plane in us-west1.
priya_solutions: Also flagged security: must be VPC peering + customer-managed keys. Enterprise contract required.
sarah_sales: Proposed commercial terms I'm thinking:
- Duration: 6 weeks POC
- Reserved capacity: 8xA10g equivalent (monthly proration)
- Burst allowance: up to 16 GPUs for 2 hrs/day; billed at 1.6x base rate during burst window (discounted from on-demand)
- Network & KMS add-on: standard enterprise + one-time onboarding fee
- Cap: total monthly spend capped at $XXk for trial
Can deal-desk approve a special burst rate and proration?

lisa_se: Can you paste the numbers you used to get $XXk? need to justify to finance.
sarah_sales: Sure — rough calc used our rate card:
Base A10g reserved rate: $2.20/hr (committed)
Burst uplift (proposal): 1.6x -> $3.52/hr for burst hours
Billing example (4-week POC w/ proration):
- Reserved: 8 GPUs * $2.20 * 24hr * 30d * (6/12 months proration factor) = $\u003ccalc1\u003e
- Burst: (16-8)=8 GPUs * $3.52 * 2hr * 5d * 4wks = $\u003ccalc2\u003e
I left placeholders — finance wants exacts before sign-off.

tom_salesops: tagging @deals-bot for rate override request. We need to record: customer, start/end, SKU mix, cap, special uplift.
deals-bot: /rate-override created — ID #RO-2026-332. Please populate the spreadsheet: https://redwood.co/sales/overrides

priya_solutions: Two technical asks that could be blockers:
1) Can we guarantee KMS integration within POC timeline? (security sign-off)
2) Can we provision the mixed GPU pool with autoscaler rules to ensure burst capacity is reserved when needed?

ryan_enginfra: KMS: yes — we have a standard onboarding runbook, estimate 3 business days. Mixed pool + autoscale: doable but needs a short ops playbook; risk is preemption of A100-sim on cloud spot providers. Recommend we offer a burst SLA: best-effort for A100-sim, guaranteed for A10g.

lisa_se: So commercial ask tweak: make burst guarantee only for A10g and best-effort for A100-sim. Also add a clause: if burst fails X times, automatic credit of Y% applied.
sarah_sales: That sounds reasonable. @tom_salesops can you route to legal/deal-desk with those terms? Include RO-2026-332.

tom_salesops: Will do. Quick Q for approvals: do we need executive sign-off for the uplift (1.6x) or can ops sign it? I think anything that changes base uplift >+50% from list must go to revenue ops director.

lisa_se: 1.6x is +60% vs standard on-demand multiplier — probably needs director sign-off.

tom_salesops: Ok will escalate to @rebecca_revops. I’ll attach the POC SOW and security checklist.

priya_solutions: I'll send the KMS runbook and a minimal playbook for the mixing/autoscale setup to the thread — helps legal quantify risk.

sarah_sales: Thanks all. Objective: get deal-desk + revops sign-off by EOD so we can start provisioning next Monday. Any objections?

ryan_enginfra: No objections. Ops will prep the provisioning request after sign-off.

deals-bot: RO-2026-332 status updated: escalated -> revops review. Link: https://redwood.co/ro/RO-2026-332

lisa_se: :thumbsup:

sarah_sales: Great — will update customer that we're in revops review. Filing thread notes to CRM.
